body.name: Centered local feasible objective
body.construction: \(\widehat Q_{a,n,\tau}(t)=nh_{a,n}^{-2}\sum_k\sum_{i\in I_k}\mathbf1\{A_i=a\}(\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(X_i)\vee\widehat b_{a,n})^{-1}[\rho_\tau\{Y_i-q_a(\tau)-th_{a,n}/n\}-\rho_\tau\{Y_i-q_a(\tau)\}]\). Population quantities only center and normalize this proof process.
